newsitem.title: USA: Belden completes purchase of Intech Cable.
newsitem.headline: Belden completes purchase of Intech Cable.

text.p: Belden Inc said Wednesday it completed its acquisition of the assets of Intech Cable Inc of Hudson, Mass., for an undisclosed price.
Belden announced plans to acquire the former Independent Cable Inc, a maker of specialty wire and cable, in October.
Intech posted revenues of $34 million in fiscal 1995, Belden said. Its primary clients are telecommunications companies.
Belden designs and markets wire, cable and cord products for electronic and electrical markets, posting annual revenues of $609 million.
